USAGE:
  sediment release [-h] --reason REASON
                   {inference_calls,developer_decisions,ci_outcomes,pushes,pull_request_merges,pull_request_revisions,edit_observations,rejected_edits,retry_linkages,session_commit_observations,repository_renames}
                   fact_id

  release one quarantined fact by id

ARGUMENTS:
  {inference_calls,developer_decisions,ci_outcomes,pushes,pull_request_merges,pull_request_revisions,edit_observations,rejected_edits,retry_linkages,session_commit_observations,repository_renames}
  fact_id

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reason REASON
